lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: RIKU, GET AWAY FROM THAT COMPUTER [beat] I KNOW YOU HAVE THE PRINCIPAL'S MASTER DRIVE HIDDEN UNDER THE COUCH!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Nix, chill out [beat] you're acting like a total psycho just because I'm playing a game in the basement at midnight.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Don't lie to me [beat] because I saw the encrypted folder with Principal Huda's private signature blinking on your screen!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Both of you shut up [beat] before Mom comes down here and finds out what we really did with the school server keys.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, Tuli, you're involved in this too [beat] I thought you were the one person I could actually trust in this house!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: She's not just involved, Nix [beat] she's the one who paid me to bypass the firewall so she could delete her suspension record.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: That’s not the whole story [beat] and if Nix finds the red file in the basement safe, we are all going to jail tonight.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I don't care about your records [beat] I want the file on my grades that Kamal has been using to blackmail our family!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Check the bottom drawer of the old workbench [beat] the drive is taped behind the power outlet where nobody ever looks.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I found it [beat] but wait, why is there a live GPS tracker attached to the casing and why is it currently beeping?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Because I knew exactly which one of you greedy little thieves would come back for the evidence [beat] and now I have you.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Principal Huda, how did you get into our basement [beat] and why are you holding my Mom's spare set of house keys?

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: I gave them to her, Nix [beat] because some secrets are better kept by the school than by a son who can't stop digging.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nix looked at his mother's cold eyes [beat] and realized the real spy wasn't a student, but the person who tucked him in at night.
